fields.description: Skyscape Altius is an apartment tower in Sobha Hartland 2, forming part of the Skyscape collection. Its published layouts include conventional one- and two-bedroom homes alongside study-equipped variants marketed as 1.5 and 2.5 bedrooms. The developer also lists three-bedroom apartments; specification and views depend on the release and unit.

overview: The original brochure separates suite area from balcony area and links plans to particular unit numbers and floor bands. A buyer should compare that exact plan, especially when a study/store room is marketed using a half-bedroom label.
research.locationNote: The own developer page locates Altius in Sobha Hartland 2, Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Lagoon and skyline views shown in marketing are orientation-dependent.
research.priceLabel: Developer-advertised starting reference · subject to stock
research.priceNote: The developer page advertises AED 1.95m subject to inventory availability. Property Finder retains an earlier AED 1.7m launch headline. Different dates and selected homes explain why neither figure proves a currently allocatable unit; request a dated quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder shows a 60% construction/40% handover option and a separate 20% booking/40% construction/40% handover option. The displayed stages use the latter only. No current developer-dated instalment sheet was found, so dates and additional charges remain unverified.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports December 2028, shown as Q4 2028. This is an estimate for Altius, not confirmation of a contractual delivery date or another tower’s programme.
